author: Marcus R. Brown
description:
Scheduled autoheal runs have had no pushable git remote, so every fix the agent produced degraded to `working-dir` mode and had nowhere to land. The daily autohealing report (#1665) has flagged this "fixes never persist" pattern for weeks.

## Root cause

The checkout step uses `persist-credentials: false` to keep the PAT out of `.git/config` on the fork-PR-head comment path. Nothing restores a credential afterward for the paths that legitimately need to push, so `fro-bot/agent` runs with an unauthenticated remote.

`marcusrbrown/mrbro.dev` already solves this; sparkle never got the equivalent step.

## Change

Writes the PAT to `http.https://github.com/.extraheader` after checkout, masked via `::add-mask::`.

Gated to the 05:00 autoheal cron and dispatched autoheal runs only:

```yaml
if: >-
  (github.event_name == 'schedule' && github.event.schedule == '0 5 * * *')
  || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.mode == 'autoheal')
```

This is tighter than the mrbro.dev original, which gates on `github.event_name == 'schedule'` generally. Sparkle runs autoheal and maintenance on separate crons, and `MAINTENANCE_PROMPT` forbids opening PRs — it only updates one perpetual issue, which the API token already covers. So the 17:00 maintenance cron is excluded. Review-mode dispatch is excluded for the same reason.

Mention and `issue_comment` runs are deliberately excluded: the agent classifies those as credential-withheld and fails closed if it finds an on-disk `http.*.extraheader`, so writing one there would break the agent rather than enable push.

The credential goes to disk rather than env or the gh credential helper because the agent scrubs its child environment.

## Verification

- `actionlint .github/workflows/fro-bot.yaml` — exit 0
- YAML parses; the step lands between `Setup project` and `Run Fro Bot`
- 32 additive lines, one file, no existing lines modified
